Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

r300ya 0.10.0

  • Fixed parsing of the retelling page: 300.ya.ru changed its markup, and the old selectors no longer matched anything. Selectors now ignore the generated svelte-* suffixes and fall back to <meta> tags.
  • Fixed the authorization header: it is now Authorization: OAuth <token> instead of Bearer OAuth <token>.
  • token defaults to the YA300_TOKEN environment variable.
  • Errors are now raised with stop() instead of being printed with message(), and have classes (r300ya_error_token, r300ya_error_api, r300ya_error_parse, r300ya_error_input) so they can be handled with tryCatch(). Error messages include the reason reported by the service.
  • The source page is no longer downloaded just to check that it exists, and the token is no longer checked with a separate request: one API call does both.
  • The result gains a theses data frame with the detailed retelling grouped by chapters, and a print() method.
  • Requests use a package user agent and retry on transient errors.
  • Dropped the stringr dependency; requires R >= 4.1.0.
  • Tests no longer need network access or a token.
  • New vignette vignette("r300ya"); the README is now in English, with a Russian version in README.ru.md.
  • Package website: https://kobzevay.github.io/r300ya/.
  • Documented the main restrictions of the 300.ya.ru terms of use.

Developed by Andrey Kobzev.
